UPDATE long_running_task_proof
             SET path_to_proof = ?,
                 cycles = ?,
                 proof_state = 2,
                 total_time_to_proof = ?,
                 proving_time = ?,
                 zkm_version = ?,
                 block_end = ?,
                 public_value_hex = ?,
                 proof_size = ?,
                 updated_at = ?
             WHERE block_start = ? AND chain_name = ?
